clauses.heading: About this policy
clauses.body: Rippit-inspired DemoCo (fictional) operates an online music discovery service for adults. This policy explains how we handle information when you create an account, discover events, read reviews, save favorites, or contact us.

clauses.heading: Information we collect
clauses.body: We collect your name, email, account credentials, postal address, declared state of residence and saved events. We also collect device identifiers, approximate location and activity on our website.

clauses.heading: How we use information
clauses.body: We use information to provide accounts, recommend local events, respond to support requests, and keep the service secure.

clauses.heading: How we disclose information
clauses.body: We use providers to host the service, deliver email and help us understand first-party activity. We do not sell personal information.

clauses.heading: How long we keep information
clauses.body: We keep information for as long as we need it to provide our service and meet our obligations.

clauses.heading: Your choices
clauses.body: You can edit your profile, remove saved events and unsubscribe from promotional email in account settings. Contact support if you want to close your account.

clauses.heading: Security
clauses.body: We use access controls and other safeguards to protect information. No online service can guarantee complete security.

clauses.heading: Age restriction
clauses.body: Our service is intended for adults aged 18 and older.

clauses.heading: Policy updates
clauses.body: We may update this policy as our service changes. We will post the updated policy here.
